offering_description.value: Runs online auctions for salvage and used vehicles, connecting insurers and other vehicle sellers with dismantlers, rebuilders, dealers and individual buyers.

primary_products.value: Salvage vehicles; used vehicles sold from owned inventory

primary_services.value: Online vehicle auctions; vehicle remarketing; vehicle collection and storage; title processing

customer_segment.value: B2B: Insurers, vehicle dealers, fleet operators, dismantlers, recyclers and vehicle rebuilders; B2C: Individuals selling vehicles and eligible individuals buying auction vehicles

end_markets.value: Automotive insurance; used vehicles; automotive repair and rebuilding; vehicle dismantling and recycling

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Buyers and sellers pay fees associated with vehicle auctions; service fees: Vehicle collection, storage, title processing and related remarketing services; subscription: Buyer memberships that provide auction participation privileges; product sales: Resale of vehicles purchased into owned inventory in certain markets
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees; subscription; product sales

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Connects vehicle sellers with commercial and individual buyers through online auctions; service provider: Collects, stores and processes sellers' vehicles for auction; asset operator: Operates vehicle storage yards that support auction and remarketing services; distributor: Purchases and resells used and salvage vehicles in certain markets
value_chain_position.category: software / platform; service provider; asset operator; distributor

geography_served.value: global: Operations across North America, Europe, Brazil and the Middle East, with an international buyer base

company_size.value: Large international auction operator with an extensive vehicle yard network and a broad commercial buyer base

specialization.value: related lines: Salvage and used vehicle auctions with related collection, storage and title processing services

distribution_channels.value: online: Proprietary website and mobile auction platform; direct sales: Direct relationships with insurers, dealers and fleet sellers; own locations: Vehicle yards provide inspection, collection and pickup access; agents / brokers: Registered brokers facilitate purchases for buyers who need licensing assistance
distribution_channels.category: online; direct sales; own locations; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Vehicle auction and dealer licensing, salvage title requirements, and environmental rules for vehicle storage yards, overseen by motor vehicle and environmental authorities

notes: No website text was supplied; descriptions reflect model knowledge, and geographic coverage, fees and licensing requirements vary by market.
